title: Obama Jokes About Killing Jonas Brothers With Predator Drones
summary: A short clip of Barack Obama at the 2010 White House Correspondents Dinner joking that the Jonas Brothers should fear predator drones. It is posted by Michael Moore's channel with commentary on civilian drone deaths.
why: Cited as an example of a joke about violence that could be stripped of context, or as a comparison when other politicians' jokes are criticized.

quote.text: here's Obama unambiguously joking about drone-murdering the Jonas Brothers
